name: FUN_STREAM_STEPS_B
description: This table contains options of functional process details with the execution information.

columns.name: STREAM_STEP_ID
columns.description: Functional process stream step options unique identifier.

columns.name: STREAM_TYPE_STEP_ID
columns.description: Functional process  stream step types reference identifier.

columns.name: STREAM_ID
columns.description: Functional process options reference identifier.

columns.name: STEP_PROCESS_CODE
columns.description: Thematic or individual job process.

columns.name: STEP_PROCESS_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the job process to be executed.

columns.name: STREAM_STEP_CODE
columns.description: The code for a business job stream.

columns.name: PROCESS_EXECUTION_CODE
columns.description: Job process execution type via automation process.

columns.name: SEQUENCE
columns.description: Sequence of the job process execution.

columns.name: INITIATION_EVENT
columns.description: The event which triggers this step.

columns.name: COMPLETION_EVENT
columns.description: The event which is triggered when this step completes successfully.

columns.name: SCHEDULE
columns.description: Schedule content in blob format.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Schedule request identifier of a business job process.

columns.name: PREPROCESS_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Process type executed before the strep (Java or PL/SQL).

columns.name: PREPROCESS_PACKAGE
columns.description: Full path of the Java or PL/SQL package

columns.name: PREPROCESS_API
columns.description: Java method or PL/SQL procedure details.

columns.name: STEP_OPERATION
columns.description: The logical operation performed on the predecessor step conditions. Values can be LOGICAL_AND or LOGICAL_OR (Default).

columns.name: TIMEOUT_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Timeout value associated with the step, which is represented in minutes. Example:5.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether record is enabled or not for automation process run.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
